oracles.tool: cfn-lint (nested templates, identity joins and Lambda handlers resolved by the adapter)

notes: L3 re-measured (wave ll2, IF-C6, 2026-11-05, fathom c5e6b7a6d): xref_precision 1 and xref_recall 1 (427 of 427), up from .9415 (402 of 427). The 25 missed bindings were node handlers the javascript dialect did not extract (O721); wave lf3 (LB-F384, 0f4244a8) fixed that and this measurement is the first since: serverless-patterns now binds 376 of 376 handlers, powertools 9 of 9, aws-cloudformation-templates 19 of 19, with the 20 nested and 3 identity-join edges unchanged. The grade does not move: the xref family's truth is tier C, and a tier-C family caps L3 at good (design 1.3). No tier-A oracle reports a handler's file and symbol or an identity join: see docs/bench/readings/iac-facts/c6-cloudformation-l3.md for the search (cfn-lint, AWS SAM CLI 1.171.0, cfn-lsp-extra, the registries, SCIP and LSIF, runtime tracing) and the written ceiling. The SAM CLI's own stack and function providers do reproduce the 20 nested-template edges (20 of 20) and report all 404 handler functions with a CodeUri that holds the file the truth names, a partial tier-A confirmation that does not lift the family

Wave c3 measurement, superseded by the wave ll2 note first in this list: L3 (wave c3, LB-F368..LB-F371, 2026-10-10): xref_precision 1 and xref_recall .9415 (402 of 427), tier C, so L3 is met at good (a tier-C family caps at good, §1.3). The truth is cfn_oracle.py's -xref-out (tier C: cfn-lint resolves none of it), every entry carrying its edge and its referenced entity, so the comparison is at entity granularity: 20 templates nested by a local TemplateURL or Location (10 AWS::CloudFormation::Stack, 10 AWS::Serverless::Application, all on serverless-patterns; LB-Q-cloudformation-rest's trigger fired), 3 identity joins (an AWS::Logs::LogGroup named /aws/lambda/<name> to the function whose literal FunctionName is <name>; no subject's alarm watches a metric a template of it declares, so the metric join is checked by fixture, TestIngest_CloudWatchAlarmJoins), and 404 Lambda handler bindings by the runtimes' own rules, each confirmed in its file (Python's ast; a line pattern for JavaScript, TypeScript, Java and Ruby). fathom draws all 23 nested and identity edges and 379 of the 404 bindings, and nothing outside the truth; the 25 missed bindings are node handlers the javascript dialect does not extract (an export whose value is a wrapper call, module.exports.x = async () => {}: O721). Handler recall .9381 and precision 1 over the three subjects whose handler code is in the repository (the SAM subject's 197 functions name code its checked-out subpath does not hold)

definitions and references are tier A: cfn-lint 1.52.1's own decode (cfnlint.decode.decode, through cfn-lint's bundled interpreter: its YAML loader reads each short form as its long form and marks every node's line), 8,857 definitions (templates, parameters, mappings, conditions, resources, outputs) and 8,093 reference pairs agree both ways. The truth is a resource's or output's Ref to a declared parameter or resource, Fn::GetAtt to a declared resource ([A, B] or A.B), a resource's DependsOn, a Condition attribute or Fn::If naming a declared condition, and (wave c3, LB-F368) a Fn::Sub's ${X} or ${X.attr} naming a declared resource where CloudWatch writes it (Dimensions[].Value, a MetricStat's Dimensions, AlarmActions, OKActions, InsufficientDataActions, LogGroupName); it is cross-checked against the tool's own graph (Template(...).graph): of its 5,754 edges 5,413 are in the truth, 341 come from a Fn::Sub's ${} names elsewhere (which the dialect does not read, so neither side counts them) and none is unexplained, and no truth pair between resources is missing from the graph (the graph has no parameter or condition edges; the decode supplies those)

not claimed: a Fn::Sub string's ${} names outside the CloudWatch properties, Fn::FindInMap's map, Fn::ImportValue and Export names (cross-stack, not cross-file), references from a Conditions entry, SAM Globals as entities (the handler binding reads them), the Rules section, Fn::ForEach resources, a .template file (no extractor reads the extension); a CFNMetric (a metric filter's metric, canonical key) and a TelemetryIdentity are outside the kind intersection, which cfn-lint does not name (excluded_by_kind), and are checked by fixture (testdata/cloudwatch.yaml, testdata/telemetry.yaml)
